{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-wy-c","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"1776868e108bb9391d413a90c18b5db9991e2c1b78d7d413455e224425c762b2","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-wy-class-c:lineage:1","source_registry_sha256":"f2806994ac56e29c3588fb4e8e2cc870c5f64d0616933994765d31d7841ccbe9","source_liveness_sha256":"e9e98c5695424e30c400f1e14b2593178d09ca723f8f00581c9655dcae32ca6c"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C","chunk_id":"C.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Licensing eligibility, identification and tests","heading":"C — Licensing eligibility, identification and tests","learner_facing":true,"markdown":"## C — Licensing eligibility, identification and tests
FACT_ID: sec01-F01 | anchor: A01
Legal driving in Wyoming requires a valid driver license, instruction permit, intermediate license or restricted license. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec01-F02 | anchor: A01
Wyoming's Driver Services Program within WYDOT issues the state's driver licenses. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec01-F03 | anchor: A01
Federal employees need no Wyoming license when they operate vehicles owned or leased by the United States government. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec01-F04 | anchor: A01
Armed Forces members stationed in Wyoming and their dependents need no Wyoming license while holding a valid license from their home state. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec01-F05 | anchor: A01
Full-time students at the University of Wyoming or a Wyoming community college need no Wyoming license if their other-state license is valid. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec01-F06 | anchor: A01
A driver licensed in another Driver License Compact state may initially use that license in Wyoming, but must surrender it within one year of Wyoming residency. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec01-F07 | anchor: A01
A person with driving privileges suspended, canceled, denied or revoked in any state is ineligible for a Wyoming license. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec01-F08 | anchor: A01
Failing any required portion of the driver-license examination prevents an applicant from receiving the license. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec01-F09 | anchor: A01
A person judged legally incompetent is among those ineligible for a Wyoming license. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec01-F10 | anchor: A01
The handbook's general ineligibility list includes people younger than 16. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec01-F11 | anchor: A01
Habitual alcohol use appears among the handbook's listed reasons for license ineligibility. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0005]

FACT_ID: sec01-F12 | anchor: A02
A violation of United States immigration laws is a listed barrier to obtaining a Wyoming license. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec01-F13 | anchor: A02
The noncommercial Class C category described here excludes motorcycle operation. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec01-F14 | anchor: A02
For the Class C vehicle category described in the handbook, the single vehicle or combination must have a GVWR below 26,001 pounds. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0006]

FACT_ID: sec01-F15 | anchor: A03
An applicant must supply legal identity and Wyoming-residency evidence to obtain a Wyoming license. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-F16 | anchor: A03
The licensing process requires knowledge, vision and driving-skills examinations. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-F17 | anchor: A03
An applicant younger than 18 also needs a release signed by a legal parent or guardian. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-F18 | anchor: A03
An instruction permit is available starting at age 15. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-F19 | anchor: A03
Limited driving privileges through an intermediate license are available at age 16. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0007]

FACT_ID: sec01-F20 | anchor: A04
A first-time license or ID applicant must provide a state-certified birth certificate, valid United States passport or immigration documents as legal identification. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-F21 | anchor: A04
If the applicant's last name differs from the verification document, proof of the name change is required. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-F22 | anchor: A04
A marriage certificate, divorce decree or court order can document an applicant's name change. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-F23 | anchor: A04
Applicants must verify their Social Security number with a Social Security card, W-2 form or financial or banking statement displaying that number. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-F24 | anchor: A04
A license holder who changes address must notify the department in writing within 10 days. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-F25 | anchor: A04
Wyoming residency proof requires two acceptable documents showing a residential address rather than a post-office box. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-F26 | anchor: A04
Vehicle title or registration documents are acceptable evidence of Wyoming residence when they show the residential address. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-F27 | anchor: A04
Property-tax, mortgage, rental or lease documents can establish Wyoming residency when they show the residential address. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-F28 | anchor: A04
Federal tax documents with a Wyoming address are among the accepted residency proofs. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-F29 | anchor: A04
Statements from a Wyoming bank or credit union may serve as residency proof if they show the residential address. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-F30 | anchor: A04
Other legal documents showing a Wyoming residential address may also be accepted as residency evidence. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-F31 | anchor: A04
Wyoming's vision standard requires 20/40 acuity using both eyes, with or without glasses. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-F32 | anchor: A04
The required combined horizontal visual field is at least 120 degrees. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec01-F33 | anchor: A02
In the Class C towing category described here, the towed vehicle's GVWR must not exceed 10,000 pounds. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wy-c:wyoming-department-of-transportation-dri:handbook:pdf-0006]

Misconceptions: General license eligibility and a younger person's permit path are separate categories; vision screening and written testing are separate requirements.
Mnemonics: Recall index: identity, residence, vision, knowledge, driving; this is an authored organizer for the cited requirements.
Glossary: Recall terms: instruction permit, intermediate license, restriction code, vision screening and skills test.
